q1.question: Is Radar free to use?
q1.answer: Yes. Browsing deals, saving favorites, and setting up alerts are all free for diners.

q2.question: How are deals verified?
q2.answer: Every listing links to its source — the restaurant's own site or a public list of local deals — and shows when it was last verified, or when it was listed if it hasn't been verified yet. We re-check listings against the restaurant's own page and mark one whose last check is more than a month old as Re-checking.

q3.question: How often is the list updated?
q3.answer: Listings are added and corrected by hand, usually a couple of times a week, and a deal with an end date is marked as ended once it passes. Whether a deal is on right now is worked out from its schedule at the moment you look.

q4.question: Can I get notified about deals near me?
q4.answer: Yes. Set your home area and pick a day in your dashboard, and Radar sends a roundup of deals near it once a week, or on the days and at the time you choose with Radar Pro. Email alerts are opening gradually, so you may join a waitlist first.

forCreators.pageDescription: Share the deals your audience already knows about, and earn a share of every Radar Pro subscription your link brings in.
forCreators.heading: The best deals never make it to a website
forCreators.intro: Radar finds the offers restaurants publish. You know the ones they only ever post to a story. Bring those in, and earn from every Pro subscription your link sends us.
forCreators.step1Body: Tell us your handle, your channel, and who watches it. We read every application ourselves.
forCreators.step2Body: Approved creators get a tracked link and a workspace showing visits, sign-ups, and what people did next.
forCreators.step3Body: You take a share of every Radar Pro payment from anyone who subscribes through your link, for as long as they stay: 20% of each monthly payment, 10% of each yearly one.
forCreators.termsHeading: What you earn, in plain numbers
forCreators.termsRates: A dollar out of every five on monthly subscriptions, and five out of every fifty on yearly ones. Yearly is the smaller share of a much bigger number — one yearly sale is worth about five months of monthly commission, and it arrives the day it happens.
forCreators.termsHold: Commissions clear after 30 days, which is the window for refunds. After that you can send your balance to your own bank through Stripe.
forCreators.termsDisclosure: Tell your audience you are paid. Every post, story, or video that shares your link or recommends Radar has to say plainly that you are a paid Radar partner, for example "#ad", "Paid partner of Radar", or "I earn a commission from Radar". Put it where people see it before they tap, not only in your bio or behind a "more" link, use the language of the post, and say it out loud in videos. Only share deals you would recommend anyway, and never say you were not paid.
forCreators.termsMonitoring: We check. Radar reviews posts that use creator links and will ask you to fix a missing or unclear disclosure. If a post stays unfixed, or misleads people about a deal or about Radar, we can pause your link, withhold the commission earned through that post, or end the partnership.
forCreators.termsAppStore: Subscriptions bought inside the Radar iPhone app do not earn a commission. Apple takes those payments, so there is no Radar payment to share. Send people to the website to subscribe — your link already goes there, and the app signs in with the same account afterwards.
